notes: Cathcart, Wellington and West Ave at Robert, Cannon and Barton. Barton and Cannon centres sit just off the drawn area, so they were placed half a street width (~205 px) beyond the block lines. The West Ave centre is the west curb plus a half width. The two Barton points both lean ~4 m the same way (possible modern realignment at Barton), but they are within limits. The Ferguson/rail-yard strip on the left (x<2400) has no direct control. Bounded by Ferguson (rail yard edge), Barton, West Ave and Cannon centres.
